en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 299 - It is narrated from Musa bin Bakr that he said:

I was in the company of Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s) and I never saw anything being brought for the Imam, but that it came to Mufaddal and many a times saw people bring something that the Imam did not accept; on the contrary he said: Deliver it to Mufaddal.
